pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: High-contrast, dark-pigmented polygonal regions exhibiting high-frequency micro-serrations (starburst edges) at the pixel boundaries. Spatial area of patches decreases significantly from the anterior neck to the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous network. Path thickness is non-uniform, widening at triple-junction nodes and narrowing between large adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile. The silhouette is composed of dense, short vertical filaments creating a fuzzy, non-linear edge against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large localized lesion on the mid-flank characterized by greyish, crusty textural disruption and a total loss of standard pelage pigmentation, appearing as a thick, plate-like surface anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Dendritic, leaf-like projections on the margins of the lower flank patches, creating a highly irregular and jagged pixel-level boundary compared to standard geometric polygons.
